title: 为什么会饿
subtitle: 肚子在提醒你
character: wearing a warm orange t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, warm gouache painting on textured paper, soft rounded shapes with clean brown outlines, palette of warm orange, wheat yellow and cream, gentle brush texture

pages.zh:
快到吃饭时间了，
我的肚子
咕噜咕噜叫了一声。
我明明没有动它，
它为什么自己叫呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a kitchen with one hand on his tummy, looking down at it, surprised.

pages.zh:
吃下去的饭，
会被身体拆成很小的糖。
这些糖顺着血跑遍全身，
给我们力气跑、力气想事情。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one plate of food on the left of a cream background, one arrow to the right, and many small round specks spreading out along a wide line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
血里糖的多少，
叫「血糖」。
吃过饭以后它高一点，
过了几个小时，
它就慢慢降下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one line across a cream background that rises after a plate symbol on the left and then slopes down steadily to the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
血糖一降下来，
身体就给大脑发个信号：
该吃饭啦。
大脑收到，
我们就觉得饿了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wide line on a cream background sloping down to a low point, one arrow going up from that point to a simple brain shape above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
胃也在提醒你。
它空了以后会收缩，
把里面的空气挤来挤去，
咕噜——
那个声音就是这么来的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two stomach shapes side by side on a cream background: the left one full and rounded, the right one empty and squeezed narrow with two small curved lines beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以饿不是坏事。
它是身体在说话，
告诉你该加油了。
就像车子快没油了，
仪表盘会亮一下。
pages.scene: One simple fuel gauge on a cream background with its needle near the low end and a small light beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
吃得太快，
大脑还来不及收到
「饱了」的信号，
我们就已经吃多了。
所以要慢慢嚼。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two clocks side by side on a cream background: the left one with a short arc marked, the right one with a much longer arc, and one bowl under each. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的东西一吃下去，
血糖蹿得很快，
可是掉得也快，
没多久又饿了。
糖果就是这样。
pages.scene: Two lines on a cream background: one that spikes up sharply and drops just as sharply, and beside it one that rises gently and comes down slowly. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
米饭、面包、燕麦这些，
身体要慢慢拆，
糖一点一点放出来，
所以能撑得久一些。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bowl of rice on the left of a cream background and one long gentle slope to the right with several evenly spaced small specks along it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
早饭最要紧。
睡了一整夜，
身体已经用掉很多。
不吃早饭，
上午就没力气也坐不住。
pages.scene: One breakfast on a cream background: a bowl, a boiled egg and a glass of milk arranged on a table, with morning light from one side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
饿的时候先喝口水，
有时候那只是渴。
真的饿了，
就好好坐下来吃，
不要边走边吃。
pages.scene: One glass of water and one bowl side by side on a cream background, with a chair drawn beside the bowl. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我坐下来，
一口一口慢慢吃。
吃到一半，
肚子就不叫了。
原来它一直在跟我说话。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a table eating slowly from a bowl, holding it with one hand, calm and content.
